# 8123 - TRI-STATE quad 2-input data selector/multiplexer

Package DIP-16 · family 8000 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/8123.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/8123.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 48 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![8123 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/8123.png) | ![8123 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-8123.png) | ![8123 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-8123.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | S | input |  |  |  |
| 2 | A1 | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | B1 | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | Y1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G |
| 5 | A2 | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | B2 | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | Y2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | Y3 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G |
| 10 | B3 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | A3 | input |  |  |  |
| 12 | Y4 | output |  | three-state | enabled by G |
| 13 | B4 | input |  |  |  |
| 14 | A4 | input |  |  |  |
| 15 | G | enable | low |  | controls pins 4, 7, 9, 12; when not enabled: float |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 4,7,9,12 | Yn = (S' AND An) OR (S AND Bn) when G'; Z when G high | With G (strobe/enable) low, each Y follows its A input when S is low and its B input when S is high. With G high all four outputs float. |

## Not known

- Switching values read from a partly garbled text layer in column order (min/typ/max of the DM71/81 23 column).

## Notes

Datasheet: pin equivalent of 74157 / 9322, with three-state outputs.
